issues.description: The stray-to-PTE invariant compares a child PTE's target address with its parent node ID instead of the stray record's physical address.
issues.rationale: For a valid non-root child `nid`, `protocol_allocate` writes the parent PTE as `Alive(paddr)` and adds the false stray `(nid, paddr)`. The invariant shadows the quantified address with `let pa = get_parent(nid)` and requires `get_paddr(offset) == pa`; when the allocated physical address differs from the parent node ID, the produced state violates the declared invariant. The problem proof masks the invariant with an `assume`. Direct repair fa698a4e renames the quantified address to `paddr`, keeps `pa` for the parent ID, compares the PTE target with `paddr`, and replaces the corresponding assume with an assertion. An independent reviewer confirmed the variable-shadowing counterexample and repair attribution.
issues.source_evidence:
after/lock-protocol/src/spec/rcu/tree.rs
136: forall |nid: NodeId, pa: Paddr|
138:     self.strays.contains_key((nid, pa)) &&
141:     let pa = NodeHelper::get_parent(nid);
145:     &&& self.pte_arrays[pa].get_paddr(offset) == pa

Repair fa698a4e preserves the parent as `pa` but compares `get_paddr(offset)` with the quantified `paddr`.
issues.verification: Primary and independent source review confirmed the linear commit chain, concrete address counterexample, and direct repair. Historical Verus was not executed.
